Scope note vs original ask: byte-offset pointer arithmetic into the *interior of a STRUCT* (crossing struct field boundaries via ADR(x)+offset) is NOT supported - this interpreter has no per-Cell declared-type/size tag, so that would need a much larger type-tagging/layout rework than this ticket's fixtures require. Flagged per the ticket's own conditional ask; struct-to-struct or whole-struct-as-bytes copies aren't covered, only array-of-byte buffers.

Implemented __ISVALIDREF intrinsic in Engine.EvaluateCall (IsValidRef helper): resolves the reference's Cell and returns TRUE when its value is non-null. Unbound REFERENCE TO defaults to null -> FALSE; REF=-bound reference aliases target Cell -> TRUE (incl. zero-valued targets). Added IsValidRefTests (unassigned->FALSE, bound->TRUE, zero-target->TRUE, FB_SFC2-style guard-clause). Full suite green.

Fixed: EvaluateBinary now special-cases '='/'<>' when either operand is a Pointer or null (unbound pointer). Bound pointers compare by underlying target (ArrayValue+Index for array-element pointers, Cell reference otherwise); a bound pointer never equals 0/null. Added PointerEqualityTests.cs covering bound-vs-zero, unbound-vs-zero, same-target, different-target cases. Full suite (222 tests) green.
Fixed: MEMCPY/MEMSET/MEMMOVE now resolve destAddr/srcAddr/value/n by name first, falling back to positional args with a shared index (mirrors BindParams), instead of hardcoded PositionalArgs[index].
